translation: It grows beside the waters of Changshan and Shangdang. Gathered as flowers in the eleventh month, dried in the shade. (杏仁 (xìngrén) is its envoy; with 紫菀 (zǐwǎn) it is good; it fears 皂莢 (zàojiá), 硝石 (xiāoshí), and 玄參 (xuánshēn); it fears 貝母 (bèimǔ), 辛夷 (xīnyí), 麻黃 (máhuáng), 黃 (huángqí), 黃芩 (huángqín), and 青葙 (qīngxiāng).)
